## Description

Problem list editing in the encounter: ICD-10 search (code + description), add/update problems with verification state (Verified, Added today · verified, Patient reported, Provisional), onset, status (active/resolved). Coded diagnoses link to the encounter for later claims (P5).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ICD-10 search returns results by code or words in < 300 ms.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each problem stores code system/version, verification state, author and encounter.
- [ ] **AC3.** Provisional problems are visually distinct and not exported as confirmed diagnoses.
- [ ] **AC4.** Code set version is configurable per country (decision recorded).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
